question: Shah-e-Hamadan Mosque is located on the banks of the river_______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jhelum**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Shah-i-Hamdan or Khanqah-e-Molla** is one of the oldest mosques in **Srinagar**. 
 
• Located on the banks of River Jhelum.
 
• The mosque was originally **built in 1359 and underwent reconstruction in 1732**. 
 
• It is the first mosque to be **built in Srinagar by a Muslim ruler, Sikander Butshikan**, in the memory of preacher Mir Syed Ali Hamdani.
 
• Syed Ali bin Shahab-ud-Din Hamadani Abidi (1314-1384) also known as "Shah Hamdan" (King of Hamad
